newsitem.title: USA: Guatemala to use bond issue for gov't programs.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala to use bond issue for gov't programs.

text.p: The republic of Guatemala plans to use revenues from an upcoming $150 million global bond issue to finance government investment programs, Guatemalan officials said Wednesday.
The issue was expected to price July 29 and to have a maturity up to 10 years.
"It's going to provide financing to the investment programs that form part of the budget and peace programs," Guatemal's Central Bank President Edin Velasquez said on a conference call.
Guatemala plans to proceed with the issue despite recent emerging market volatility that caused Argentina to postpone the launch of a $750 million global bond issue last week.
"The character of the (Guatemalan) economy makes us not worried about those possible effects," said Guatemala's Finance Minister Jose Alejandro Arevalo.
BankBoston, lead manager of the issue, had no comment.
